llm_prompt_text:
Analyze this vulnerability.
    
    Description: CWD ~root command in ftpd allows root access.
    Affected Software (CPEs): cpe:2.3:a:ftp:ftp:*:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:a:ftpcd:ftpcd:*:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
plain_english_summary: A vulnerability in the FTP daemon (ftpd) allows an attacker to gain root access to the system by using the 'CWD ~root' command.

llm_prompt_text:
Analyze this vulnerability.
    
    Description: Buffer overflow in passwd in BSD based operating systems 4.3 and earlier allows local users to gain root privileges by specifying a long shell or GECOS field.
    Affected Software (CPEs): cpe:2.3:o:bsd:bsd:4.2:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:o:bsd:bsd:4.3:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
affected_technology: BSD based operating systems 4.3 and earlier
plain_english_summary: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the 'passwd' utility of BSD based operating systems (versions 4.3 and earlier) allows a local user to gain root privileges. This can be exploited by providing an excessively long input for the shell or GECOS fields.
